role: future external interface for governed Damar workflows/capabilities
does_not_expose: independent orchestrator, authority, mission store, memory store, capability registry, or identity
flow: external authenticated request -> canonical session/identity binding -> Manager -> ActionIntent -> existing authority -> capability/actuation -> verification -> Audit Ledger -> read-model/event
authn: client credentials, scopes, expiry, network restrictions, rate/quota policy
authority: external authentication is not action authority; consequential requests require normal authority/approval
model_boundary: may reference Model Gateway/aliases; model selection is never action authorization
failure: external agent/tool failure is not Damar Core failure; return explicit UNKNOWN/DEGRADED and provenance
